lesson_title: LESSON 09: Master ADE Synthesis & Final Comprehensive Exam
topic_title: Course Summary, Master Principles & Final Synthesis
prompt: What speed reduction is required by the Move Over Act when passing a stopped emergency vehicle?

options.text: Slow to 20 mph below posted limit (or 5 mph if speed limit is less than 25 mph)
Slow to 10 mph below posted limit (or 15 mph if speed limit is less than 30 mph)
Maintain full posted cruising speed provided you activate four-way flashers
Slow down to exactly thirty-five miles per hour on all interstate highway lanes
